frame: One plain round plate on a plain table, seen from slightly above, centred, same size on the page, one fork lying beside it, bare plain wall behind. Only the state of the plate surface changes.
sentence_nl: Het eerste bord is schoon, maar het tweede bord is vuil.
sentence_en: The first plate is clean, but the second plate is dirty.

frame: One plain shirt hanging by two pegs from a straight washing line, front view, whole shirt in the same folds, same size on the page, bare plain wall behind, no sun and no clouds. Only the drops and the puddle change.
sentence_nl: Mijn shirt is nat, maar jouw shirt is droog.
sentence_en: My shirt is wet, but your shirt is dry.

frame: One plain book standing upright on a plain shelf board, side view, same height on the page, a pencil leaning beside it for scale, bare plain wall behind. Only the thickness of the book changes.
sentence_nl: Het eerste boek is dik, maar het tweede boek is dun.
sentence_en: The first book is thick, but the second book is thin.

frame: One adult standing in the middle of a straight plain path seen from the front, whole figure, arms hanging, same size on the page, plain grass edges on both sides. Only the width of the path changes.
sentence_nl: Dit pad is breed, maar dat pad is smal.
sentence_en: This path is wide, but that path is narrow.

frame: One plain room seen from the front with the same window and curtains, the same table, the same chair and one table lamp, one adult in the middle, same viewpoint. Only the light changes, and with it how the adult moves.
sentence_nl: Deze kamer is donker, maar die kamer is licht.
sentence_en: This room is dark, but that room is light.

frame: One plain kitchen knife lying flat on a plain wooden board next to one small round apple, side view, same size on the page, bare plain wall behind. Only the edge of the blade changes.
sentence_nl: Dit mes is scherp, maar dat mes is bot.
sentence_en: This knife is sharp, but that knife is blunt.

frame: One plain cup with a handle standing on a plain table, side view, same size on the page, bare plain wall behind, nothing else on the table. Only whether the cup is in one piece changes.
sentence_nl: Mijn kopje is heel, maar jouw kopje is kapot.
sentence_en: My cup is whole, but your cup is broken.

frame: One adult man sitting at a plain table with a plain plate in front, upper body, front view, same size on the page, bare plain wall behind. Only the plate, the hands and the face change: an empty plate and folded hands, or a full plate pushed away.
sentence_nl: Deze man is tevreden, maar die man is ontevreden.
sentence_en: This man is satisfied, but that man is dissatisfied.

frame: One plain table with chairs and cups on it, seen from the front, same table size, one window on the wall behind, same viewpoint. Only the number of people at the table and how close they sit changes.
sentence_nl: Alleen aan tafel voel ik me eenzaam, maar met vrienden is het gezellig.
sentence_en: Alone at the table I feel lonely, but with friends it is cosy.

frame: One adult standing, front view, upper body and both arms visible, same size on the page, bare plain wall behind. Only the tension in the shoulders, arms and hands changes.
sentence_nl: Voor het examen ben ik gespannen, maar daarna ben ik ontspannen.
sentence_en: Before the exam I am tense, but afterwards I am relaxed.

frame: One plain pillow lying on a plain bed, side view, same size on the page, a small cup standing beside it for scale, bare plain wall behind. Only the shape of the top of the pillow changes.
sentence_nl: Mijn kussen is plat, maar jouw kussen is bol.
sentence_en: My pillow is flat, but your pillow is round and bulging.

frame: one small tree and one washing line with three towels in a plain garden, seen from the front, a plain fence behind and a plain sky, same size and place on the page. Only what the air does to the tree and the towels changes.
sentence_nl: Vandaag is het winderig, maar gisteren was het windstil.
sentence_en: Today it is windy, but yesterday there was no wind.
